hook.line: The app where brands pay creators to make their ads, and it paid me $75,000 in five months.
hook.visual: Woman talking to camera with one finger up; serif title types on 'the app that paid me $75,000 in 5 months', app icon pops in at right, handwritten 'episode 2' tag.

beats.what: Face with a raised finger; title text types on word by word
Purple app icon pops in beside her head as the dollar figure lands
Handwritten 'episode 2' tag and 'corporate marketing dropout' subtitle complete the title card
Earnings screenshots ($55,612 and $20,590) pop in as she says $75,000
App Store page screenshot floats over her shoulder as she names the app
Handwritten list 'no pitching yourself / no negotiating' at top
Her own creator profile screenshot appears as she explains setup
Social accounts screen while she says follower count does not matter
Handwritten teaser 'what to look for / what to pass on' for the next episode

why_it_works: The money figure is on screen within 2 s and backed by earnings screenshots at 8 s, result before method
Screenshots float beside her face instead of replacing it, so she never leaves the frame
Handwritten notes for lists and teasers feel personal and contrast with the serif title
Next-episode teaser at the end gives a reason to follow without asking
weaknesses: No explicit spoken CTA; the guide link is only in the caption
Single-word captions at chest height sit over busy clothing and gestures
The setup steps are thin; most of the value is promised for episode 3
for_robert: Let the result appear as an object next to Robert's head in the first 2 s (a number or icon popping in), and have Fred hold up the proof screenshot rather than cutting away from Robert.
